quote: We are happy to introduce AI Performance in Bing Webmaster Tools, a new set of insights that shows how publisher content appears across Microsoft Copilot
owner_action: Verify the site in Bing Webmaster Tools, open AI Performance and export citations, cited pages and grounding queries each month.

quote: The branded queries filter is now available to all eligible sites.
owner_action: In the Search Console Performance report, apply the branded and non-branded filter and read the two groups separately.

quote: New agentic browsing category added to default config
owner_action: Make /llms.txt answer 200 or 404, never a server error: Lighthouse flags server errors on it and marks a 404 Not Applicable.

quote: Google Analytics now provides a dedicated way to measure and analyze traffic originating from popular AI assistants.
owner_action: Open the Default Channel Group in GA4 reports, check that the AI Assistant channel shows, and add a custom rule only for AI referrers that still land in Referral.

quote: we're excited to announce the launch of new Search Generative AI performance reports in Search Console
owner_action: Open the Generative AI performance report in Search Console and read AI impressions by page, country and device.

source_name: Google Search Central Blog (note added to the 3 June post)
quote: As of August 31, 2026, we've rolled out these insights to all websites worldwide.
owner_action: Check the Generative AI performance report is now visible for every property, in every country you serve.

source_name: Search Console Help: Search generative AI control
quote: As of August 31, 2026, we’ve rolled out this control to all websites worldwide.
owner_action: Open Settings > Search generative AI in Search Console and confirm each property is set to include the site, unless the owner chose otherwise.

owner_action: Read the French AI impressions in the Generative AI performance report and check which French questions now show an AI Overview.
